source.title: Utilizing the planarian voltage-gated ion channel transcriptome to resolve a role for a Ca2+ channel in neuromuscular function and regeneration.

injury: two transverse amputations, pre-pharyngeal and post-pharyngeal

intervention.duration: not stated as a number in the text
intervention.description: Worms fed negative-control dsRNA (Smed-six-1) were cut into trunk fragments and bathed in a submaximal concentration of praziquantel from the time of cutting.

readout.method: scoring of head and tail axis identity in regenerates

notes: Text gives the control value as 35+/-2% of regenerants in the two-headed class at a submaximal praziquantel concentration; n is not stated for the Fig. 4A cohorts, so the percentage is entered as the count and n_total is null. normal=65 is the complement, derived here. The praziquantel concentration is described only as submaximal, so dose is null. This is the drug reference arm for the RNAi comparisons, hence arm_role positive_control (A) rather than test (B); the RNAi background is the Smed-six-1 negative control named in Methods.

adjudication.note: same number; A's positive_control role kept over B's test

source.title: Utilizing the planarian voltage-gated ion channel transcriptome to resolve a role for a Ca2+ channel in neuromuscular function and regeneration.

injury: two transverse amputations, then posterior blastema removed at 24 h after amputation

intervention.timing: RNAi feeding cycles before amputation; posterior blastema removed 24 h after amputation
intervention.description: Worms fed negative-control dsRNA were cut into trunk fragments and the posterior blastema was cut away again 24 hours later, with no drug exposure.

readout.method: scoring of head and tail axis identity in regenerates

notes: Text gives an approximate value (~1%) of regenerants in the two-headed class for this surgical protocol in the control-RNAi background; n not stated, so the percentage is the count and n_total is null. The normal count is the complement, derived here. Value is approximate, hence low outcome confidence. This arm has no electrical or ionic agent itself: it is the matched negative-control background for the Cav1B RNAi blastema-removal arm and is kept as the control arm of that pair.

adjudication.note: A and B agree; agent recorded as the negative-control dsRNA
